title: Derivative of the mollified set integral: D(∫_G ρ(· − z)dz)(x)w = ∫_G Dρ(x − z)w dz (parent Step 1)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let G ⊆ ℝ^N be Lebesgue null-measurable, and let ρ : ℝ^N → ℝ be C¹ with compact support. Put u(x) := ∫_G ρ(x − z) dL^N(z). Then for all x, w ∈ ℝ^N, Du(x)w = ∫_G Dρ(x − z)w dL^N(z). Here Du(x) = fderiv ℝ u x is Lean's total Fréchet derivative (which is 0 at points of non-differentiability) and Dρ(t) = fderiv ℝ ρ t. (The proof shows that u is in fact differentiable at every x, with Du(x) = ∫_G Dρ(x − z) dz.)
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : Set (Rn N)) (ρ : Rn N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet G volume → ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → ∀ x w : Rn N, fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ ∫ z in G, ρ (x - z)) x w = ∫ z in G, fderiv ℝ ρ (x - z) w
